title: Polyhedral normed spaces: the structural theorem and locally finite tilings
summary: A fundamental result due to Fonf (1981) asserts that the unit sphere of every polyhedral Banach space is covered by true faces of the unit ball. The principal aim of our paper is to study the validity of the same result for polyhedral normed spaces and present some applications. Our first main result is that if $X$ is a polyhedral normed space with property ($Δ$), then its unit sphere is covered by algebraic true faces.
